name: Tyler Stahl
headline: Portfolio-Focused Software Engineer
summary: Full-stack software engineer with experience shipping React/TypeScript and Laravel applications at nonprofit scale, plus hands-on applied AI systems work.

featuredProjects.name: Glen Rock AI Guild
featuredProjects.problem: A community AI club needed a mention-driven Slack assistant that could answer simple questions immediately while spinning up the right domain specialists for deeper technical, data, insurance, and writing work—without requiring a public webhook URL.
featuredProjects.solution: Built a CrewAI multi-agent backend with a Supervisor that classifies Slack mentions into simple vs detailed intents, dynamically selects Engineer / Data Analyst / Insurance SME / Web Designer / Writer agents, runs on Google Gemini with model failover, and exposes FastAPI health/roster endpoints plus Google Docs/Drive sync with mock fallback.
outcomes: Intent-based Supervisor routing with fast-path simple answers and dynamic specialist crew assembly for complex prompts.
Slack Socket Mode integration (no public webhook/ngrok) with threaded Guild reports and `/agents-list` roster card.
Google Docs/Drive create-and-sync path with personal OAuth or service-account credentials and mock fallback when unset.

featuredProjects.name: Development Knowledge Vault
featuredProjects.problem: AI coding agents on new projects rediscover the same deploy, auth, eval, and security practices instead of reusing distilled patterns from prior agent and product repos.
featuredProjects.solution: Built a Vercel-hosted MCP server that exposes markdown engineering patterns as tools (`list_patterns`, `get_pattern`), with dual auth on one URL—Clerk OAuth for cloud clients and an optional shared-secret Bearer for local/curl—so Cursor, Gemini Spark, and other MCP clients can pull operational preferences and prior solutions at request time.
outcomes: Production MCP endpoint serving a curated pattern corpus (deploy, auth, evals, PII, multi-agent, YAML SOT, and related practices).
Dual-acceptance auth documented and shipped so the same URL works for OAuth clients and Bearer-configured IDE/curl without smart surface detection.
Personal Cursor skill (`knowledge-vault`) that steers agents to query the vault before inventing process.

featuredProjects.name: InSummery.AI
featuredProjects.problem: Family scheduling information lives in messy emails, texts, and PDFs; calendar apps assume tidy manual entry and do not detect multi-child childcare gaps or real-time disruptions with a human still in control.
featuredProjects.solution: Built a Google ADK 2.0 multi-agent concierge that masks PII, triages and extracts schedule data, pauses below 80% confidence for HITL clarification, maintains a multi-child schedule matrix with absolute/relative gap analysis, and syncs disruptions to Google Calendar—shipped as a Kaggle + Google 5-Day AI Agents Intensive Consult-track capstone.
outcomes: Capstone writeup published on Kaggle for the vibecoding agents competition.
Public demo app and GitHub repository with CLI and Firebase web modes.
Deterministic eval harness with absolute quality gates (e.g., 90% triager accuracy, 80% workflow pass rate) and baseline regression tracking.
